limitations: Full audit scope was reviewed with targeted/security-level execution. This is an incomplete baseline audit, not release acceptance or independent certification.

No real browsers, viewports, screenshots, accessibility trees, startup controls or actual browser worker/CSP lifecycle were executed at the owner's request. Controller probes use bounded fake DOM/worker replies; source integration was challenged separately.

No canonical Docker/WASM/launcher rebuild, complete feature matrix compilation/runtime, packaged launcher binaries, checksums/signing/attestation release bundle or GitHub Actions execution. Seven fresh default HTML pages and three minimal compositions were built; default Dash Deriver failed, and its old page was rejected as stale.

No full vector/statistics replays, full-size Argon2/scrypt/password KDFs, mass PDF/card/QR generation, live providers, regtest, wallet funds or real secrets. One mistakenly selected statistics file timed out and is excluded from completed test totals.

The crypto reviewer completed source inspection but its proposed test preparation was interrupted by an automatic cybersecurity content filter. The coordinator subsequently completed ordinary bounded synthetic conformance/rejection/recovery tests. Independent decryption of a weak-recipient record without a private key remains unexecuted; the confidentiality impact is inferred from the bound dependency path.

Npm advisories returned zero for150 packages. Five offline Cargo.lock scans returned zero known vulnerabilities using1296 cached advisories, with unknown advisory database freshness and yanked-package checks disabled. Unmaintained atomic-polyfill and paste warnings remain informational.

Exact service model identifiers and reliable reasoning-effort metadata were unavailable for all phases; null means unknown. Five reviewers contributed distinct scopes plus coordinator follow-up; no claim of independent certification.

No proof of post-GC zeroization, compiler erasure or secret residue recoverability. Captured buffer references demonstrate explicit cleanup only. No active unauthorized network/write call or real secret egress was demonstrated.

Installed Evo SDK4.1.1 delegates unfunded-address key selection to opaque WASM. Compatibility with explicit-null complete Maps is checked; actual empty-proof inclusion/omission semantics remain a gap.

Pinned MnemoCode source169 files is byte-matched to the checked source manifest but intentionally unreleased/dirty; CI rejects it. Its release handover remains a prerequisite. MHFE0.6.0 browser release pin is retained unchanged.

Crypto-backed known answers and narrow independent Go derivation checks were sampled. Full per-coin/path/script/BIP38/Silent Payments cryptographic acceptance was not replayed. Broad Taproot self-comparisons are not counted as independent oracles.

Original Node/Rust sandbox EPERM failures and harness/CLI initialization errors are retained separately from scoped successful reruns. No assertion, vector, offline boundary or integrity gate was relaxed.

Command memory sampling and serialization protect the coordinator's child process group; unrelated host processes are outside its enforcement. Source fingerprints remained stable throughout recorded product checks. Audit evidence is ignored and uncommitted.
assessment: Baseline only. Full execution and release acceptance are incomplete. No fixes, commits, pushes, tags or releases were performed.
